text: にくいねーッ　だいとうりょう！
note: 「よっ、大統領！」 ("Hey, Mr. President!") is a stock Japanese shout for buttering someone up, originally a call from the audience; Bill is laying on the flattery. The English keeps only "chief".
claim: 「よっ、大統領！」 is a set Japanese phrase shouted to flatter or cheer someone on.

check.quote: 人をおだてたり、ほめそやしたりして呼びかけるのに用いることば。芝居などで役者をほめていうかけ声にも使う。「待ってました！ 大統領」
check.note: 「よっ、大統領！」 ("Hey, Mr. President!") is a stock Japanese shout for buttering someone up, also used as a call from the audience to praise an actor; Bill is laying on the flattery. The English keeps only "chief".
